8Mwrfvq-GeY.title: How Robot Brains Dream and Explore Unseen Worlds
8Mwrfvq-GeY.label: GTC 2025
8Mwrfvq-GeY.description:
Generalist robots are here, but training them effectively poses a challenge due to the scarcity of both real and synthetic data, as well as the difficulty of scaling human demonstrations.

#NVIDIAIsaac GR00T-Dreams, a cutting-edge blueprint built on #NVIDIACosmos, generates large-scale synthetic trajectory data from minimal human demonstrations, enabling robots to quickly learn a wide array of new actions.

Cosmos Predict, fine-tuned with single-task teleoperation data, generates 2D synthetic ""dream"" videos of potential future states. Cosmos Reason then evaluates and selects the optimal dreams, from which the blueprint creates 3D action trajectories for robot training.

This innovative approach brings developers one step closer to overcoming the challenge of robot data.

Read the press release: https://nvda.ws/4kuqGWu

GmNkYayuaA4.title: Getting Started with CUDA and Parallel Programming | NVIDIA GTC 2025 Session
GmNkYayuaA4.label: GTC 2025
GmNkYayuaA4.description:
Join one of CUDA's architects on a journey through the concepts of parallel programming: how it works, why it works, why it's not working when you think it should be working, and in particular why it's different on a GPU from a CPU. 

We'll look at different approaches to parallel programming in CUDA and how to take advantage of the hardware it runs on. This is the next episode in what has become a series looking at the way that CUDA and the GPU work, and why they work this way. This session will focus on how to think about parallel programming on a massively-parallel GPU and why that might be different to what you're used to. If you've never even written a parallel algorithm then you'll learn all sorts of new things, but even if you're a ninja you'll walk away with some new tricks up your sleeve.

Speaker: Stephen Jones, CUDA Architect, NVIDIA

Key Takeaways:
▫️Introduction to parallel algorithms
▫️Hardware and even software design is running up against the laws of physics, which will change computing in a fundamental way
▫️How parallel programming on a GPU is different to what you might be used to
▫️Techniques for getting the most out of CUDA

To the creators, the pioneers, and the builders of the future: CUDA was made for you.

This panel will explore the journey from AI mastering strategic games to tackling complex, real-world problems. rsBobT9INP4.title: How AI Factories Maximize Tokens, Power, and Profit With NVIDIA DSX
rsBobT9INP4.label: GTC 2026
rsBobT9INP4.description:
As global demand for AI infrastructure accelerates, NVIDIA Omniverse™ DSX provides a digital twin blueprint for designing, simulating, and operating AI factories at maximum efficiency. 

DSX helps developers optimize token throughput, resilience, and energy use across physical, electrical, thermal, and network systems. By connecting simulation tools, operational data, and dynamic power management through an open ecosystem of partners, DSX enables faster design, virtual commissioning, and intelligent live operations. 

Once deployed, AI agents and real-time orchestration continuously adapt infrastructure performance, turning every watt into higher compute output and revenue.

Read press release: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-releases-vera-rubin-dsx-ai-factory-reference-design-and-omniverse-dsx-digital-twin-blueprint-with-broad-industry-support

uv8va8bIqus.title: The 50-State Plan: Public-Private Models for AI Infrastructure and University Transformation
uv8va8bIqus.label: GTC 2026
uv8va8bIqus.description:
As AI becomes the definitive engine of economic and academic growth, the race is on to democratize access to high performance computing across the United States. This panel explores "The 50-State Plan," a strategic roadmap for building robust, statewide AI infrastructure through innovative public-private partnerships. The session brings together visionary tech-industry pioneers, leaders from the National Science Foundation (NSF), and executives from top-tier research universities to discuss the shift from isolated pockets of innovation to unified strategies for university transformation and mission success in the age of AI.

Learn how your organization can participate in this nationwide effort to bridge the digital divide and accelerate the next era of discovery.

x8lsdIoQfjg.title: Disney Characters Coming to Life at NVIDIA GTC 2026
x8lsdIoQfjg.label: GTC 2026
x8lsdIoQfjg.description:
Ever wondered how Disney's characters make it from the screen to reality? 🎬

Behind the magic is physical AI:
- Newton & Kamino: Leveraging the open-source, GPU-accelerated Newton framework and Disney’s Kamino solver for artist-centric reinforcement learning. 
- Expressive Motion: Training motion diffusion models and policies to push robotic characters to perform at the limits of hardware.
- Believable Autonomy: Utilizing onboard perception for autonomous navigation and unique, engaging guest interactions with authentic character motion.

Come join Moritz Baecher at #NVIDIAGTC to see how physical AI enables Disney to bring characters to life in the real world within months.

 Tues, Mar 17 | 9:00 AM PT
